statement: The locked constraints: only Daniel changes the intention (SEMENTE §3/§6 and INT-* via intencao: PR with Intention-Change:); login, credentials, money, other people, security/target TAIL exemptions, trust guards, stop criteria, and GitHub workflows/rulesets are owner-locked and never self-authorized; Anthropic inference quota is not a fixed one-Claude-Max strategic cap (when it is the bottleneck, the session proposes a raise to Daniel with why and expected gain, while current authorized spend stays tracked against supply.anthropic_monthly_usd and buying/raising quota remains money); gross AWS spend stays within its measured ceiling; external verification counts, never session self-assessment; no backward compatibility, no force push, no secret printed.
